types.raku: Experience raku firing at Omaha Pottery Studio. This dramatic firing technique produces unique metallic lusters and crackle patterns. Special raku workshops available seasonally.
types.soda: Experience soda firing at Omaha Pottery Studio. Sodium introduced at peak temperature vapor-glazes the work, leaving flashing and orange peel no brushed glaze can imitate.
types.gas_reduction: High-fire stoneware, cone 6 electric and gas reduction firing.
